title: Luxuriant Velvety American Chicken Casserole
description: A cozy American dish featuring tender chicken, english mustard, and a hint of tadka spice, all wrapped up in a velvety sauce, steamed to perfection in a bamboo steamer.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, english mustard, tadka spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cut chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the cream mixture.
In a separate bowl, mix together the shredded cheddar cheese and cooked white rice.
Add the frozen peas and carrots to the cheese and rice mixture and stir to combine.
Spoon the chicken and cream mixture into the bamboo steamer.
Top the chicken with the cheese, rice, and vegetable mixture.
Place the bamboo steamer over boiling water and cover with a lid.
Steam the casserole for 25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is velvety.
Remove the casserole from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
